_help: All menu and catalog items live in this one file. The page builds itself from it.
Every item has English (en) and Spanish (es) text side by side. Edit both.
price: a number like 1.5 (shown as $1.50), or null to show 'Ask' / 'Pregunta'.
orderable: true = shows a + / Add to cart button so customers can order it for pickup.
sizes (clothing): sizes to choose from, English and Spanish labels in the same order, e.g. S/M/L = CH/M/G. Leave it out for one-size items.
fromPrice (clothing): true shows the price as 'From $45'.
image (clothing): path to a photo in assets/img/catalog/ (640x800, portrait 4:5).
showPrices: set to false to hide every price on the site.
These are SAMPLE items and prices until the real menu arrives. See README.md.
